subject: Music Production
title: Metallica's Death Magnetic Controversy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Metallica's Death Magnetic Controversy.

hook.text: Metallica's 2008 album 'Death Magnetic' was mastered so loud that it caused audible distortion throughout.

buildup.text: Fans discovered that the Guitar Hero video game version of the same songs had better dynamic range.

discovery.text: Over thirteen thousand fans signed a petition demanding the album be remastered with less compression.

twist.text: Mastering engineer Ted Jensen publicly stated the decision was made before the files reached him.

climax.text: The Death Magnetic controversy became the loudness war's most public example of artistic damage.

punchline.text: A video game had better sound than the actual album.

quiz.question: What did fans discover about Death Magnetic?
options: The vinyl sounded different from the CD
The Guitar Hero version had better dynamic range than the CD
The album was recorded entirely live
